changelog:
BOSS SNAKE REWORK! The boss is now a snake that moves toward food, eats it, and grows. Position your snake to make the boss run into you — head-on or body contact damages it. Each hit removes 2 boss segments; when none remain, it dies.

YOU HAVE TO MANUALLY GO INTO YOUR FILES APP AND YOUR DOWNLOADS FOLDER TO INSTALL THIS UPDATE. Hopefully next update this won't be required. I'm working on it.
